basic_info.description: Welcome to Esprit Park #516! This top-floor 2-story townhome style condo offers an incredible lifestyle in one of Dogpatch's most esteemed communities. Rarely-available yet highly sought-after 2-car parking comes with the home as well as a separate storage unit. Towering ceilings and a wall of glass lead from the great room to the full-width outdoor deck, which overlooks the quiet courtyard and has peek-a-boo views of the skyline, Bay, and Sutro Tower. The open living/dining/kitchen area is an entertainer's dream, and the indoor/outdoor flow flawless. The gleaming kitchen features stainless appliances including a Bertazzoni gas range, Liebherr refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, and disposal. An island-on-wheels provides versatility and breakfast bar seating. A built-in office nook and powder room complete the space. On the lower level are two en-suite bedrooms, both with walk-in closets and luxe baths. The primary easily accommodates a king size bed and both baths feature dual vanities. The lower hall has a laundry closet with stackable washer/dryer. Esprit Park is surrounded by some of SF's most highly acclaimed coffee shops, restaurants, and shops. Exciting things are happening nearby including Dropbox, Uber, OpenAI, Y Combinator, & Gusto. Easy downtown and Peninsula commute!
